class.name: NNPointGrid2DSearchSpace
class.brief_description: Search space that generates a grid of 2D sample points around a node.
class.description: Generates a lattice of [Node2D] candidate positions centered on [member point_grid_parent_node], optionally snapped to the 2D navigation mesh ([member use_navigation_mesh_positions]). Use this for tactical positioning queries in 2D (such as finding a flanking spot, retreat point, or clear firing position) when no hand-placed marker nodes exist. Choose a layout preset with [member point_grid_lattice_type] or customize density with [member grid_size], [member point_grid_base_spacing_vector], and [member point_grid_lattice_vector]. Keep spacing reasonable to avoid generating too many points. To visualize points while debugging, add a direct [Node2D] child named [code]DEBUG[/code] (for example, a [Sprite2D]); it will be duplicated for each generated point instead of plain [Node2D]s.

members.member: Width and height of the generated grid, centered on [member point_grid_parent_node].
[NavigationServer2D] map [RID] used when [member use_navigation_mesh_positions] is enabled. Defaults to the viewport's 2D navigation map.
Local offset applied to all generated points before navigation snapping.
Generated [Node2D] candidate points parented under [member point_grid_parent_node].
Step size between consecutive base points along X and Y. Smaller values increase density. Must be positive.

Preset lattice pattern ([code]Square[/code], [code]Triangular[/code], [code]CenteredRectangular[/code], [code]Rectangular[/code], or [code]Custom[/code]). Choosing a preset updates [member point_grid_base_spacing_vector] and [member point_grid_lattice_vector].
Local offset from each base point to its paired lattice point (for creating square, staggered, or triangular grids).
[Node2D] that owns and centers the generated point grid (usually the AI actor).
If [code]true[/code], snaps each candidate point onto the closest point on the 2D navigation mesh before scoring.
